items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was Lover Come Back to Me.

ctx.x: Quicksilver. That was Lover Come Back to Me. So it was Quicksilver on one side – Lover Come Back to Me, but I did it in a way that they kind of jibed. Moten Swing
with whatever tune we did. I can’t think of what it was. We did tunes like that. We did How High the Moon and . . .
